title: Token comparison is not constant time
desc: compare_tokens returns `a == b`, which short-circuits on the first differing byte and leaks the length of the matching prefix to a caller that can time it. Use hmac.compare_digest instead.

title: Attempt store grows without bound
desc: record_attempt appends to a module level dict that is never pruned, so a process that has seen many addresses keeps every one of them for its whole lifetime. Evict entries outside WINDOW_SECONDS on write.

title: Lockout threshold is off by one
desc: is_locked_out compares with `>` against MAX_ATTEMPTS, so an account is only locked after MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1 failures. Compare with `>=` to honour the documented limit.

title: login does not record the lockout rejection
desc: When is_locked_out returns True, login returns early without calling record_attempt, so a locked account's continued attempts never extend the window and the lockout expires while an attack is still running.

title: New module has no test coverage
desc: src/security.py ships with no tests, while tests/test_auth.py covers the helpers it sits beside. Add a test module for the rate limiter before the diff lands.
